common.name: Igama
dashboard.title: Bona ukusebenza ngokucacileyo.
dashboard.subtitle: Windows · Android
dashboard.choosePlatformHelp: Khetha iqonga eyodwa. Uvavanyo isixhobo nokukhetha ithagethi yovavanyo kwenzeka esikrinini esilandelayo.
dashboard.recentSessionsSimpleHelp: Qhubeka novavanyo kutshanje okanye uvule ingxelo wako.
dashboard.packagedUnavailable: Ubume sephakheji asifumaneki. Kwimo yophuhliso, qalisa i-pnpm dev:server.
dashboard.noDevicesMessage: Qalisa iseva yasekuhlaleni ukuze ubone le khompyutha nezixhobo e-Android eziqhagamshelweyo.
dashboard.recentSessionsHelp: I-Windows inokusampula i-CPU kunye nememori yenkqubo. I-Android Beta isampula i-CPU, imemori, ibhetri kunye nenethiwekhi. I-FPS ifuna ukurekhodwa okucacileyo kwe-PresentMon okanye inkxaso yeqonga esavavanywayo.
error.failedToFetch: Akukwazekanga ukuqhagamshela kuseva yasekuhlaleni. Qinisekisa ukuba i-sidecar yedeskithophu iyasebenza, okanye qalisa i-pnpm dev:server kwimo yophuhliso.
error.androidSystemScreenMessage: Ifowuni manje ibonisa Useto ze-Android okanye isikrini sesistimu. Vula usetyenziso okanye umdlalo ofuna ukuyivavanya, emva koko ukhetha Qalisa Uvavanyo kwaye.
history.noRecentSessionsMessage: Qalisa uvavanyo kwe-Windows okanye kwe-Android ukuze wakhe imbali.
history.localOnly: Kuboniswa imbali wasekuhlaleni kuphela ngoba iseva yasekuhlaleni ayifumaneki.
guide.title: Indlela yokusebenzisa i-LumaTrace
guide.subtitle: Khetha i-Windows okanye i-Android, ulandele amanyathelo zenkundla, uqalise uvavanyo, ukumise, emva koko ufunda ingxelo.
guide.mockBody: I-Mock Local Device sisixhobo sokubonisa esakhelwe ngaphakathi. Iithagethi zaso zivelisa iimethrikhi ze-mock eziphawulwe ngokucacileyo ukuze ufunde indlela yokusebenza ngaphandle kokuqhagamshela ihardware.
guide.pcBody: Ikhompyutha yasekuhlaleni ibala iinkqubo zokwenene ze-Windows. Khetha inkqubo eyodwa ukuze uqoqe i-CPU kunye nememori. I-FPS ifuna ukurekhodwa kwe-PresentMon okucacileyo.
guide.androidBody: Efowunini, vula iinketho zomphuhlisi nokulungisa iimpazamo nge-USB, ugunyazise le khompyutha, uvule usetyenziso ofuna ukuluvavanya, ulukhethe apha emva koko uqala uvavanyo.
guide.deviceConcept: Isixhobo: umthombo okuqoqwa kuwo, njengale khompyutha okanye ifowuni ye-Android.
guide.targetConcept: Ithagethi yovavanyo: usetyenziso, umdlalo okanye inkqubo ofuna ukuyilinganisa kweso sixhobo.
guide.sessionConcept: Uvavanyo: umjikelezo owodwa wokulinganisa. Kuqale, ujonge iimethrikhi, ukumise, emva koko uvula ingxelo.
support.title: Lungisa / Xela Impazamo
support.body: Qalisa ngokuzama ukuqalisa kwakhona olukhuselekileyo novavanyo izixhobo kwaye. Ukuba inkinga iqhubeka, vula ifomu elilungisiwe lokubika impazamo le-GitHub.
support.repairDescription: Qalisa kwakhona ukuqokelela kwasekuhlaleni emva koko uhlola izixhobo namathuluzi kwaye.
support.repairingHelp: Iqalisa kwakhona ukuqokelela kwasekuhlaleni kwaye ihlola izixhobo nezixhobo.
support.repairSuccess: Ukulungisa kugqityiwe. Ubume sezixhobo nezixhobo sihlaziyiwe.
support.repairFailed: Ukulungisa okuzenzekelayo akuqedwanga. Ungabika impazamo ukuze lilandelwe.
support.submitDescription: Vula ifomu elilungisiwe lokubika impazamo le-GitHub ngokucofa kube kanye.
support.include: Iinkcukacha ewusizo: inguqulelo yosetyenziso losetyenziso, inguqulelo ye-Windows/Android, imodeli yesixhobo, okuchofozile, obukulindele, okwenzekile, izithombe-skrini nokukhishwa kokuxilonga okucociweyo.
support.privacy: Ungafaki ama-token, ama-akhawunti, iindlela ezipheleleyo zasekuhlaleni, iilog ezikrwada, iifayile e-CSV ekrwada, i-logcat, i-bugreport okanye izithombe-skrini eziyimfihlo.
device.mockDescription: Idatha yokufundisa ephephile. Iimethrikhi akhiwe kwaye amakwe ngokucacileyo njengomthombo we-mock.
device.localPcDescription: Ukuthola iinkqubo zokwenene ze-Windows nokusampula i-CPU kunye nememori.
session.beginnerBody: Ekuhloleni kokuqala, khetha i-Windows, ukhethe inkqubo yosetyenziso losetyenziso esebenzayo, uchofoze Qalisa Uvavanyo, ume emva kwemizuzwana embalwa, emva koko uvula ingxelo.
session.platformSubtitle: Qalisa ngenkundla ofuna ukuyivavanya. I-LumaTrace izokuqondisa esinyathelweni esilandelayo kwaye igcine iimethrikhi angenakufumaneka njenge-N/A.
session.platformWindowsBody: Khetha inkqubo yosetyenziso losetyenziso okanye umdlalo kule khompyutha, emva koko uqala uvavanyo. Ukuba inkqubo iphuma, uvavanyo kuyama okanye kurekhodwe ukuphazamiseka okucacileyo.
session.platformAndroidBody: Vula iinketho zomphuhlisi nokulungisa iimpazamo nge-USB efowunini, ugunyazise le khompyutha, uvule usetyenziso ofuna ukuluvavanya, emva koko uchofoza Qalisa Uvavanyo. I-LumaTrace ithola ngokuzenzekelayo iphakheji elingaphambili.
session.runningHelp: Sebenzisa usetyenziso ngendlela evamile. Qeda uvavanyo ukuba usurekhode ubume ofuna ukusilinganisa.
session.defaultStep2: Landela umyalo wokuxhuma okanye wokukhetha usetyenziso oqondene nenkundla.
session.defaultStep3: Qalisa uvavanyo emva kokukhetha isixhobo nalokho ithagethi yovavanyo.
session.choosePlatformFirstBody: Emva kokukhetha i-Windows okanye i-Android, le ndawo ibonisa kuphela isixhobo, ithagethi yovavanyo nesenzo sokuqala saleyo nkundla.
session.windowsStep2: Khetha inkqubo yosetyenziso losetyenziso ngaphansi Kokuhloswe Uvavanyo.
session.windowsStep3: Chofoza Qalisa Uvavanyo. I-CPU, imemori, i-FPS nexesha besakhelo zibuyekezwa bukhoma ukuba i-PresentMon iyafumaneka; ukuba ingatholakali i-FPS ihlala iyi-N/A.
session.androidStep1: Kwifowuni ye-Android, vula iinketho zomphuhlisi nokulungisa iimpazamo nge-USB, qhagamshela intambo ye-USB uze ugunyazise le khompyutha.
session.androidStep3: Chofoza Qalisa Uvavanyo. I-LumaTrace ithola ngokuzenzekelayo iphakheji yosetyenziso losetyenziso olungaphambili efowunini.
session.mockHint: Ekujoliswe kwe-mock okokufunda ukuhamba komsebenzi kuphela. Akuwona iimethrikhi edivayisi okanye ohlelo losetyenziso wangempela.
session.androidForegroundPending: Vula usetyenziso efowunini emva koko uchofoza Qalisa Uvavanyo. Igama lephakheji lizovela apha emva kokutholwa.
session.windowsVisibleAppsHelp: Usetyenziso ezivuliwe ziboniswa kuqala. Ukusesha kuphinde kuthole iinkqubo zangemuva.
session.noWindowsTargetMatches: Akukho inkqubo ye-Windows efana nalokhu kusesha. Zama elinye igama okanye uvuselele ithagethi yovavanyo.
session.exportLogsToReportDirHelp: I-Android igcina i-ADB logcat ehlanziwe yesikhathi sovavanyo. I-Windows igcina iirekhodi eseshini ye-LumaTrace anezikhathi.
session.noWindowsTargets: Akukho inkqubo yosetyenziso losetyenziso lwe-Windows esebenzayo etholakele. Vula usetyenziso okanye umdlalo ofuna ukuyivavanya, emva koko uvuselela uhlu.
session.noAndroidTargets: Akukho ekujoliswe usetyenziso lwe-Android ngoku. Vula iinketho zomphuhlisi nokulungisa iimpazamo nge-USB, ugunyazise le khompyutha, uvule usetyenziso efowunini emva koko uvuselela.
device.title: Iinkcukacha Yesixhobo
device.subtitle: Ithagethi yovavanyo nokufumaneka kwamamethrikhi kwedivayisi ekhethiweyo yeseva yasekuhlaleni.
device.androidHelp: I-Android Beta ifuna iinketho zomphuhlisi nemvume yokulungisa iimpazamo nge-USB. Isekela ukulawula okucacileyo kokuqala/ukumisa usetyenziso, uxilongo ukubopha kwakhona inkqubo nesimo senqolobane/sempilo esihlanzekile. Ukusampula i-CPU, imemori, ibhetri kunye nenethiwekhi kufuna i-ADB. I-FPS isahlolwa.
device.pcHelp: I-PC Beta ibala iinkqubo ze-Windows zasekuhlaleni kwaye inokusampula i-CPU kunye nememori eboshelwe ku-PID. I-FPS nexesha besakhelo kufuna i-PresentMon kwaye kusavavanywa; iindlela zamafayela asebenzayo ziyafihlwa phambi kokuboniswa.
device.forceStopConfirm: Lokhu kuzomisa ngenkani iphakheji ekujoliswe kudivayisi.
session.title: Iseshini Yovavanyo
session.subtitle: Khetha iqonga, usetyenziso okanye inkqubo ekujoliswe, uqalise ukuqokelela, ukumise emva koko ufunda ingxelo.
session.deviceNetworkNotice: Izibali zenethiwekhi zesixhobo zingafaka ithrafikhi yezinye usetyenziso.
session.uidNetworkNotice: Izibalo zenethiwekhi zezinga le-UID zilinganiselwa ku-dumpsys netstats detail.
session.androidNetworkNotice: Inethiwekhi ye-Android isebenzisa i-netstats yezinga le-UID ukuba iyafumaneka, emva koko ibuyela kuzibali zesixhobo ngokunemba okucacisiwe.
session.androidFpsNotice: I-FPS kunye nexesha lesakhelo kwi-Android zisavavanywa. Ngexesha lovavanyo, i-LumaTrace izama ukuziqokelela kwizibalo zezakhelo zoluntu ze-ADB. Ukuba i-Android ayiniki datha yesakhelo ehambelanayo, ixabiso lihlala liyi-N/A.
session.pcNotice: Uvavanyo kwe-Windows kuzama ngokuzenzekelayo i-PresentMon FPS/ixesha besakhelo bukhoma ukuba i-PresentMon iyafumaneka. I-CPU kunye nememori kusaqhubeka ukuba i-PresentMon ingekhoyo. Ukutholakala kwe-PresentMon: {availability}.
session.sampleIntervalHelp: Amaxabiso amancinci aqokelela rhoqo kwaye enza iigrafu zibonakale ngqo, kodwa asebenzisa i-CPU eninzi. Amaxabiso amakhulu alula kwaye alungele uvavanyo olude, kodwa igrafu iba neenkcukacha ezimbalwa. I-100 ms lulungiselelo olumiselweyo olufanelekileyo.
session.reportOutputDirHelp: Khetha apho iingxelo yovavanyo igcinwa khona. Ukuba uvavanyo kuphela, i-LumaTrace ibhala iingxelo ye-HTML, JSON ne-CSV kule folda.
session.reportOutputDirUnavailable: Iyafumaneka emva kokuba iseva yasekuhlaleni ibike ifolda.
session.reportOutputDirChanged: Ifolda yengxelo ivuselelwe. Iseva yasekuhlaleni iqaliswe kwakhona ngokukhuselekileyo.
session.simpleSettingsHelp: Zonke ezinye useto zokuhlola zisebenzisa okuzenzekelayo olukhuselekileyo. Iimethrikhi angekhoyo ahlala eyi-N/A kwaye awazaliswa ngo-0.
session.autoStartHelp: Qalisa usetyenziso phambi kokuhlola ukuba i-PID ingekhoyo
session.monkeyFallbackHelp: Sebenzisa i-monkey -p package 1 kuphela ukuba ukuthola isiqalisi kwehluleka
session.stopTargetHelp: Misa ngenkani iphakheji ekujoliswe emva kokumisa uvavanyo
session.experimentalFpsHelp: Vula uvavanyo kwe-FPS okusavavanywa ngexesha sokumisa
session.presentMonEnableHelp: Qalisa ukurekhodwa kwe-CSV okucacileyo okunesikhathi kwe-FPS/ixesha besakhelo
session.presentMonKeepCsvHelp: Gcina i-CSV yesikhashana kuze kuhlanzwe iseshini ukuze kulungiswe iimpazamo ekuhlaleni
session.androidFpsNaNotice: I-FPS nexesha besakhelo ihlala kuyi-N/A ngaphandle ukuba uvavanyo okusavavanywa kuvelisa iimethrikhi afana nalokho okuhlosiwe. Izendlalelo ezingacacile okanye ezingekho aziguqulwa zibe yi-FPS.
session.pcCaptureNotice: Inkqubo ekhethiweyo ayiqalwa okanye imiswe yi-LumaTrace. Ukurekhodwa kwe-PresentMon kusavavanywa. Ukungabi khona kwemigqa ye-PresentMon ehambisanayo kusho ukuthi i-FPS ihlala iyi-N/A.
session.autoStopped: Usetyenziso oluhlosiwe luphelile, ngakho uvavanyo kuqedwe ngokuzenzekelayo kwaye ingxelo wengxenye wagcinwa.
session.waitingForMetricsMessage: Ixhuma kwithagethi kwaye ilinde iimethrikhi zokwenene zokuqala. Iigrafu avela ngokuzenzekelayo apho idatha ifika.
session.stopDialogMessage: Ukumisa kuphothula iimethrikhi kwaye kudale ingxelo. Akususi imbali wasekuhlaleni.
session.createDialogMessage: Uvavanyo luyaqhubeka. Kumise phambi kokushintsha ukuze ukuqokelela kuhlale kucacile.
report.title: Iziphumo Zovavanyo
report.subtitle: Khetha isiphumo ukuze ujonge i-FPS, i-1% Low, ixesha besakhelo, i-CPU, imemori nemibiko ekhishiwe.
report.deleteOneMessage: Cima u-{name} kunye nedatha yawo eqoqwe ekuhlaleni? Iifayile ombiko akhishiwe azogcinwa.
report.deleteAllMessage: Cima iziphumo yasekuhlaleni eqediwe engu-{count} kunye nedatha yayo? Uvavanyo okuqhubekayo namafayela ombiko akhishiwe kuzogcinwa.
report.recentResultsHelp: Khetha uvavanyo okuqediwe okanye okuphazamisekile ukuze ujonge ingxelo wako.
report.noResultsMessage: Qalisa ngokusebenzisa uvavanyo kwe-Windows okanye kwe-Android. Emva kokumisa, ingxelo uzovela apha.
report.coreMetricsHelp: Amanani angekhoyo ahlala eyi-N/A kwaye awazaliswa ngo-0.
report.performanceGroupHelp: Qalisa apha: i-FPS ibonisa ukuguda, ngelixa i-1% Low nexesha besakhelo kubonisa ukuzinza.
report.resourcesGroupHelp: I-CPU, i-GPU kunye nememori esetshenziswe yilolu hlelo okanye inkqubo ngexesha sovavanyo.
report.deviceGroupHelp: Amandla, inqanaba lobushushu le-GPU, ibhetri kunye nedatha yenethiwekhi ekwazile ukuqoqwa yinkundla.
report.performancePoor: Umndilili we-FPS ngu-{avg}, ungaphantsi kwe-30 FPS. Ukusebenza kubuthathaka kwaye ukutsiba kwezakhelo kunokwenzeka.
report.performanceFair: Umndilili we-FPS ngu-{avg}, phakathi kwe-30 ne-59.9 FPS. Ukusebenza kwamkelekile, kodwa imiboniso enzima isenokungagudi.
report.performanceGood: Umndilili we-FPS ngu-{avg}, yi-60 FPS okanye ngaphezulu. Ukusebenza kuhle kwaye amava kufanele agude ngokubanzi.
report.performanceUnavailable: Umndilili se-FPS asiqoqwanga, ngakho lo mbiko awukwazi ukukala ukusebenza kokubonisa.
report.stabilityGood: I-1% Low ingu-{onePercentLow} FPS ({ratio}% yesilinganiso), okubonisa ukuzinza okuhle kozimele.
report.stabilityNeedsAttention: I-1% Low ingu-{onePercentLow} FPS ({ratio}% yesilinganiso), okubonisa ukushintshashintsha okukhulu kwesilinganiso besakhelo.
report.stabilityUnavailable: Akukho idatha eyanele ye-1% Low yovavanyo ukuzinza kwesilinganiso besakhelo.
report.performanceThresholdNote: La manqanaba e-FPS sisikhokelo ngokubanzi. Umda wesantya sesakhelo, izinga lokuhlaziya isikrini, useto lomfanekiso kunye nemeko yovavanyo zinokutshintsha indlela iziphumo ezitolikwa ngayo.
report.rawPreview: Iingxelo emifushane isebenzisa iisampulu iimethrikhi ekrwada ukujonga kuqala iigrafu.
report.downsampledPreview: Iingxelo emide isebenzisa iimethrikhi zamabhakede ukujonga kuqala iigrafu. Ukukhutshwa okuluhlaza akushintshi.
report.noTrendDataMessage: Iigrafu e-FPS, ixesha besakhelo, i-CPU kunye nememori ahlala eyi-N/A ukuba iisampulu ezinombolo engatholakali.
report.exportHelp: Lokhu kuhlola kuthathe {duration}. Iisampulu iimethrikhi ekrwada angu-{metrics} ayatholakala ukuze akhishwe.
report.noSessionMessage: Khetha uvavanyo kuluhlu, okanye vula eli phepha nge-?sessionId=...
report.noPresentMonMessage: I-FPS nexesha besakhelo ihlala kuyi-N/A ukuba ukurekhodwa kuvaliwe, kungafumaneki, kungafani okanye kungacacile.
report.presentMonNotice: Ukurekhodwa kwe-PresentMon kucacile kwaye kusavavanywa. Iingxelo ayibandakanyi umxholo kwe-CSV okuluhlaza okanye iindlela ezigcwele zendawo.
report.diagnosticsNotice: Okukhishiwe kuhlanziwe kwaye akufaki okukhiphayo kwe-logcat okanye kwe-bugreport.
tools.title: Izixhobo / Uxilongo
tools.subtitle: Ubume nokuxilonga kwamathuluzi e-Android ne-Windows ekubukeni kwasekuhlaleni okucociweyo.
tools.securityNotice: I-ADB okanye i-PresentMon ingaba ingekhoyo ngaphandle kokuphahlazeka kohlelo. I-logcat, i-bugreport, i-root, ukulayisha efwini novavanyo kwe-monkey kuvaliwe ngokuzenzekelayo.
tools.toolAction.adbAvailable: Qhagamshela isixhobo ye-Android enokulungisa iimpazamo nge-USB okuvuliwe.
tools.toolAction.adbInstall: Faka i-Android SDK Platform Tools kwaye wenze i-adb itholakale.
tools.toolAction.presentMonAvailable: Vula i-PresentMon kuphela ukuba kufuneka i-Windows FPS okanye ixesha besakhelo.
tools.toolAction.presentMonInstall: Faka i-PresentMon okanye usethe indlela yayo yendawo ukuze uvule ukurekhodwa kwe-Windows FPS.
tools.noPcDeviceMessage: Ubume se-PresentMon sivela ukuba i-PC yasekuhlaleni iyafumaneka.
tools.presentMonLimit.explicit: Ukurekhodwa kwe-PresentMon kufanele kuvulwe ngokucacileyo kwaye kusavavanywa.
tools.presentMonLimit.noMatch: I-FPS ihlala iyi-N/A ukuba ithagethi yovavanyo kungafaniseki ngokuhlukile.
tools.presentMonLimit.privacy: I-LumaTrace ayidluli izimvume ze-Windows kwaye ayibandakanyi i-CSV ekrwada kwiingxelo.
packaging.statusUnavailableMessage: Kwimo yophuhliso ungaqhubeka nokusebenzisa i-pnpm dev:server.
packaging.check1: Iseva yasekuhlaleni epakishiwe ibopha ku-127.0.0.1 kuphela.
packaging.check2: I-REST kunye ne-WebSocket epakishiweyo zifuna i-Bearer token efanayo.
packaging.check3: Imfihlo ayigcinwa kuma-VITE variables, ku-localStorage, kuma-URL, kumalogi, kwiingxelo okanye ekuxilongeni.
packaging.check4: Ukuqalisa kwakhona i-sidecar kunomkhawulo kwaye uxilongo kokuphahlazeka kuyahlanzwa.
packaging.check5: Ukushintshanisa iilog kuvuliwe kumalogi ohlelo ne-sidecar.
packaging.check6: Uvavanyo kwentuthu kwesitoreji esipakishiwe kuqinisekisa ukusebenzisa kwakhona i-DB emva kokuqala kwakhona.
packaging.check7: Ama-manifest ezaziso zokupakisha ayakhiwa kwaye asadinga uhlaziyo kokukhishwa.
packaging.check8: Ukulungela ukukhutshwa kwephakheji ye-Windows kuvinjelwe kuze kuqedwe amasango okukhiqiza.
packaging.check9: Ukusayina kokukhiqiza, ukuvuselela, ukuqinisekiswa kwemibhalo esemthethweni nokusabalalisa kwe-Store akukasethwa.
packaging.rcNotice: Lesi sifinyezo sihlanganisa ukulungela kwe-sidecar, i-GUI QA yesandla, inqubomgomo yokukhishwa nobufakazi bamasango e-RC ekubukeni okucociweyo. Akusona imvume yokukhishwa kwaye i-productionReady ihlala iyi-false.
metricQuality.title: Umgangatho yedatha
metricQuality.body: Iimethrikhi angenakufumaneka ahlala eyi-N/A kwaye awazaliswa ngo-0. Idatha yokubonisa iphawulwa njengomthombo we-mock.
marker.title: Abamakishi bezehlo
marker.label: Ilebula
presentMon.permissionsBody: I-FPS ngqo ifuna ufikelelo lwexesha elinye ekulandeleni ukusebenza kwe-Windows. I-LumaTrace ngokwayo isebenza ngaphandle kwamalungelo omlawuli, kwaye i-CPU kunye nememori zihlala zifumaneka ngaphandle kofikelelo lwe-FPS.
session.fpsAccessBody: I-CPU kunye nememori sekuyasebenza. Vula ukulandelela ukusebenza kwe-Windows kanye ukuze wengeze i-FPS nexesha besakhelo.
session.fpsAccessRestartBody: Phuma ku-Windows emva koko ungena kwaye kanye. Uvavanyo kwesikhathi esizayo kuzosebenza ngaphandle kwamalungelo omlawuli.
session.fpsAccessErrorBody: I-CPU kunye nememori kusatholakala. Zama uvavanyo kwaye.
session.fpsAccessCancelledBody: Akukho okushintshile. Qhubeka ne-CPU kunye nememori okanye uvule i-FPS kamuva.
presentMon.retentionBody: Iingxelo ayibandakanyi i-PresentMon CSV ekrwada. Iindlela zasekuhlaleni ziyahlanzwa phambi kokuvela ekuxilongeni okanye kwiingxelo.
presentMon.noStatusBody: Yenza okanye uqalise uvavanyo kwe-Windows ukuze ubone ubume bokurekhodwa.
presentMon.defaultReason: Ukurekhodwa kwe-PresentMon kucacile kwaye kusavavanywa. I-FPS ikhutshwa kuphela emva kokufanisa ithagethi yovavanyo ngempumelelo.
pc.sourcePrecision: I-Windows FPS nexesha besakhelo kuvela ekuqoshweni kwe-PresentMon CSV okucacileyo kwaye kusavavanywa. I-CPU kunye nememori kusaqhubeka ukuba i-PresentMon ingekhoyo okanye ingabuyisi idatha.
android.fallbackNetwork: Izibali zenethiwekhi zesixhobo zingafaka ithrafikhi yezinye usetyenziso.
connection.label: Uqhagamshelo olubukhoma
